executorRuling.question: may G5 executor reuse G4 labelers (L1/L2/T)?
executorRuling.ruling: YES, PERMITTED — with a labeler-distinct REVIEWER SPOT-CHECK. Rationale: G5 is a mechanical proof over ALREADY-LABELED rows (familyId/URL/split recomputation + set arithmetic), not a judgment task; labeling exposure cannot bias deterministic function outputs (straddle empty/non-empty, URL hit/miss, split holdout/non-holdout are recomputable by anyone). The independence requirement attaches to LABELS (satisfied at G4 by independent L1/L2 + T), not to re-running pure functions over them. Constraints: (1) executor attests identity + G4-role (if any) on the record pre-gate; HoldoutSpecDrafter remains BARRED from everything; (2) the G5 proof artifact MUST include machine-replayable inputs (familyId sets, URL sets, split recomputations) so the reviewer re-derives the verdict independently at G5 acceptance — the reviewer spot-check, not executor identity, is the independence backstop; (3) any executor judgment call beyond pure recomputation (e.g., near-dup pair disposition rationale) must cite evidence and is reviewer-overrideable.
executorRuling.forbidden: re-labeling, new sealed reads beyond the G5 proof inputs, dev-merge, floor-claim publication before reviewer approval of the proof artifact
